title: How to Test Containerized Applications
description: Runnable companion for the containerized applications testing guide: a Compose smoke stack (postgres + app + curl probe), Kubernetes manifests with liveness/readiness probes, a kubectl smoke script and a CI gate that builds, scans with Trivy and smoke-tests.
descriptionEs: Companion ejecutable de la guía de testing de aplicaciones containerizadas: stack smoke Compose (postgres + app + probe curl), manifiestos Kubernetes con liveness/readiness probes, script smoke con kubectl y una puerta de CI que compila, escanea con Trivy y corre el smoke test.
author: Mathias Paulenko
